summary: Reproduced the independent review counterexample against candidate commit 650754532755ba75de1195f7d5231899ae9cabb5, then separated skip reasons that defer to a later cross-rank SUM from A2A/all-gather skips that already absorb the routed collective. TP1 shared output is scaled only for the former, preserving the candidate's valid DP reduce-scatterv fix without producing R + S/8 on A2A paths.

tests.what_was_measured: The candidate's five focused tests passed before correction.
On gfx950, exact candidate behavior for an A2A skip with no later SUM returned [10.25, -3.0] instead of R + S = [12.0, 4.0], maximum absolute error 7.0.
Six focused regression and boundary tests passed after correction, including deferred-SUM scaling, executed all-reduce, A2A no-later-SUM, nonreplicated, and single-rank cases.
On gfx950, A2A/no-later-SUM produced R + S and DP reduce-scatterv produced the per-rank R + S/8 contribution, both with zero maximum absolute error.

gpu_execution.evidence: Candidate failure and corrected boundary arithmetic ran on one AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, using Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015; raw logs are retained under reports/j-01c2f3ae5b2d/raw/.

remaining_limitations: Only one gfx950 GPU was assigned, so actual eight-rank RCCL reduce-scatterv and A2A transport were not executed.
DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat and GLM-5.2 weights were unavailable; no full-model serving or semantic-accuracy claim is made.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
